description: This file contains unit tests for the LayoutTestRunner and Sharder classes used in layout testing framework, including test cases for test sharding, failure handling, and lock checking.

classes.name: FakePrinter
classes.description: A mock printer class used in tests to simulate output without actual printing.

classes.name: LockCheckingRunner
classes.description: A subclass of LayoutTestRunner that checks lock handling during test execution.

classes.name: LayoutTestRunnerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for LayoutTestRunner, including failure limits and summary updates.

classes.name: SharderTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the Sharder class, testing test distribution/sharding logic.

methods.name: _runner
methods.description: Creates a LockCheckingRunner instance with default options for testing.

methods.name: _run_tests
methods.description: Runs a set of tests using the provided runner and test list.

methods.name: test_interrupt_if_at_failure_limits
methods.description: Tests that the runner correctly interrupts test execution upon reaching failure or crash limits.

methods.name: test_update_summary_with_result
methods.description: Tests that the test results summary updates correctly based on test outcomes.

methods.name: get_test_input
methods.description: Creates a TestInput object for a given test file, indicating if it requires a lock.

methods.name: get_shards
methods.description: Generates test shards based on the number of workers, parallelism, and test list.

methods.name: assert_shards
methods.description: Asserts that the actual test shards match expected shard names and test lists.

methods.name: test_shard_by_dir
methods.description: Verifies correct test sharding by directory.

methods.name: test_shard_every_file
methods.description: Verifies test sharding when each test is isolated.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two
methods.description: Verifies test sharding when tests are split into two shards.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two_has_no_locked_shards
methods.description: Verifies behavior when tests are split into two shards with no locked shards.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two_has_no_unlocked_shards
methods.description: Verifies behavior when tests are split into two shards with no unlocked shards.

methods.name: test_multiple_locked_shards
methods.description: Verifies behavior with multiple locked shards.

methods.name: test_virtual_shards
methods.description: Verifies virtual test sharding behavior with different run modes.
